admin.label: Campaigns
admin.description: Newsletters and messages to subscribers and users, and the newsletter lists.

permissions.manageDescription: Create, edit and delete newsletter lists, and see how many people are subscribed.
permissions.sendDescription: Schedule and send campaigns to newsletter subscribers and users.
permissions.sendImportantDescription: Send a message that reaches users even on the channels they turned off.
permissions.piiDescription: See the email addresses and phone numbers of newsletter subscribers.
permissions.subscriptionsDescription: See and change which newsletters you are subscribed to.

scopes.newslettersDescription: See and change which newsletters you get.

admin.title: Newsletters
admin.description: The lists people sign up to, their signup and their subscribers.
admin.createDescription: People sign up for it with the signup component or the HTML form on its page.
admin.deleteDescription: Its {count} subscriptions and their consent records are deleted with it. This cannot be undone.
admin.deleteEmptyDescription: Nobody is subscribed to it yet. This cannot be undone.
admin.forbidden: You do not have access to newsletters
admin.emptyDescription: Create a newsletter, then add its signup to a page.
admin.settingsDescription: What the newsletter is called, how people get it and what they agree to.
admin.consentVersion: Version {version}. Changing the text starts a new version; each subscription keeps the version it agreed to.
admin.noSubscribersDescription: Add the signup below to a page, and subscribers show up here.
admin.embedDescription: Put the signup on a page of this site with the component, or paste the HTML form into another site.

fields.name: Name
fields.slugHelp: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes. The signup names the newsletter by it, so changing it breaks signups that use the old one.
fields.descriptionHelp: Shown with the signup and on the account page.
fields.channelsHelp: How people can get it. SMS goes through the SMS driver the app has set up.
fields.consentTextHelp: Shown next to the consent checkbox. Changing it starts a new version, and each subscription keeps the version it agreed to.
fields.doubleOptInHelp: A new subscriber first confirms from a link in an email or SMS. Leave it on unless you collect consent elsewhere.
fields.publicHelp: Anyone can sign up through the public signup, and signed-in users see it on their account page.

form.slugRequired: Give the newsletter a URL name.
form.slugInvalid: Use lowercase letters, digits and dashes.

signup.name: Name
signup.phoneHelp: With the country code, such as +45.
signup.failed: You could not be signed up
signup.checkInboxDescription: We sent you a link. Confirm, and the newsletter starts coming to you.
signup.phoneInvalid: Write the phone number with its country code, such as +4512345678.
signup.channelsRequired: Pick how you want to get it.
signup.consentRequired: Tick the box to sign up.

confirm.title: Confirm your subscription
confirm.description: One click, and the newsletter is on its way to you.
confirm.explanation: Confirm that you want this newsletter. You can unsubscribe from every message.
confirm.doneDescription: Every message has a link to unsubscribe again.
confirm.checkInboxDescription: We sent you a link. Open it and confirm, and the newsletter starts coming to you.
confirm.noTokenDescription: Open the link from the confirmation message again, or copy all of it into the address bar.
confirm.expiredDescription: Sign up again to get a new link.
confirm.invalid: This link does not work any more
confirm.invalidDescription: It may have been used already. Sign up again if you are not getting the newsletter.
confirm.failed: The subscription could not be confirmed

unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribe
unsubscribe.explanation: You will stop getting it at this address or phone number.
unsubscribe.doneDescription: You will not get it any more. You can sign up again at any time.
unsubscribe.noTokenDescription: Open the unsubscribe link from the message again, or copy all of it into the address bar.
unsubscribe.invalidDescription: Open the link from the message again, or copy all of it into the address bar.
unsubscribe.doneTopic: You will not get these messages by {channel} any more
unsubscribe.doneTopicDescription: Turn them on again in your notification settings.

account.title: Your newsletters
account.description: Turn a newsletter on to get it, or off to stop it.
account.unverified: Your email address is not verified yet, so we send a confirmation link before the first newsletter.
account.smsHint: Sign up for SMS with the newsletter's signup form.
account.loadFailed: Your newsletters could not be loaded
account.emptyDescription: Newsletters you can sign up for will show up here.

fields.subject: Subject
fields.name: Name
fields.nameHelp: For staff only: recipients see the subject or text, never this name.
fields.channelsNewsletterHelp: Each subscriber gets it on the channels they subscribed with.
fields.channelsMessageHelp: People get it on the channels they keep on for messages; SMS is off until they turn it on.
fields.listsHelp: Everyone subscribed to one of these gets it once per channel, even when they are on several.
fields.groupsHelp: Everyone who matches one of these: a role, a team, the people who take part in an operation.
fields.groupsEmpty: No groups yet: add the groups to send to, or pick people above.
fields.emailBodyHelp: Markdown: **bold**, _italics_, [links](https://…) and blank lines between paragraphs. An unsubscribe link is added at the end.
fields.smsBodyHelp: Plain text. A line with an unsubscribe link is added at the end.
fields.pushUrlHelp: Where tapping the notification leads: a page on this site (/news) or a full URL.
fields.trackClicksHelp: Links become short links that count each recipient's clicks.
fields.trackOpensHelp: Adds an invisible image to the email. Mail apps that load images by themselves count as opens too, so the number is a rough one.
fields.importantHelp: Reaches people also on the channels they turned off for messages.

campaign.importantYes: Yes: it reaches people also on channels they turned off
campaign.notReady: Finish the draft before sending it
campaign.needsSendImportant: Sending an important message needs the permission to send important messages.
campaign.needsSend: Someone who may send campaigns sends or schedules it.
campaign.statsFailed: The results could not be loaded
campaign.audienceNewsletter: The active subscribers of these newsletters, each once per channel.
campaign.audienceMessage: These people and everyone in these groups, each once.
campaign.previewFailed: Could not count who it reaches
campaign.contentDescription: What recipients get. Each gets their own language when it is written, else the campaign's.
campaign.emailFooterNote: Each email ends with a link to unsubscribe and one to the recipient's settings.
campaign.linksDescription: Clicks on each link in the campaign.
campaign.deliveriesDescription: Who it went to on each channel, and what happened.
campaign.deliveriesFailed: The recipients could not be loaded
campaign.noDeliveriesDescription: They show up here once it starts going out. After a while only the counts are kept.
campaign.forbidden: You are not allowed to see campaigns
campaign.emptyDescription: Write a newsletter to your subscribers or a message to your users.

kinds.newsletterHelp: To the subscribers of newsletter lists, by email or SMS.
kinds.messageHelp: To users picked by name, role, team or operation, by email, SMS or push.

campaign.importantDescription: An important message reaches people on every channel you pick, also on the channels they turned off for messages. Use it only for what they must know, such as safety information or a changed time.
campaign.createDescription: It is saved as a draft. Check who it reaches, then send it now or schedule it from its page.

schedule.future: Pick a time in the future.
schedule.title: Schedule {name}
schedule.description: It goes out at this time, in batches. You can cancel it until then.

campaign.reachesNobody: Nobody would get it: check its audience.
campaign.sendImportantNote: It is important: it also reaches people on channels they turned off.
campaign.sendNote: It goes out in batches over the next minutes. Once sent it cannot be taken back.
campaign.cancelSendingDescription: What has gone out stays sent; nobody else gets it. Its counts and links are kept. This cannot be undone.
campaign.cancelScheduledDescription: It will not go out. Its texts are kept; duplicate it to send it later. This cannot be undone.
campaign.deleteDescription: The draft and its texts are deleted. It was never sent, so nobody is affected. This cannot be undone.

form.pushUrlInvalid: Use an http(s) URL or a path on this site.
form.channelsKind: A newsletter goes out by email and SMS only.
form.emailSubjectRequired: Write the subject of the email.
form.emailBodyRequired: Write the text of the email.
form.pushTitleRequired: Write the title of the notification.
form.pushBodyRequired: Write the text of the notification.

skipReasons.unavailable: No address, phone number or device

newsletter.channels: Pick at least one channel a newsletter can use: email or SMS.
newsletter.content_email: Write the subject and text of the email.
newsletter.content_sms: Write the text of the SMS.
newsletter.audience_listIds: Pick the newsletters to send to.
newsletter.audience: A newsletter goes to list subscribers only.
newsletter.important: Only a message to users can be important.

message.content_email: Write the subject and text of the email.
message.content_sms: Write the text of the SMS.
message.content_push: Write the title and text of the push notification.
message.audience: Name the people or groups to send to.
message.audience_listIds: A message goes to users; send a newsletter to reach list subscribers.

heading.title: Campaigns
heading.description: Newsletters and messages to subscribers and users, and the newsletter lists people sign up to.
